component.name: Lightmorphic Talkin
component.summary: Private, on-device dictation for the Linux desktop

description.p: Talkin turns speech into text anywhere on the Linux desktop. Hold a hotkey, talk, release - the words appear in whatever window has focus, whether that is an email, a document, a chat box or a terminal.

Everything runs on this machine. The speech model is downloaded once on first run and every dictation after that is transcribed locally - no account, no cloud service, nothing is ever sent anywhere. A personal dictionary teaches it names and jargon, a local-only history keeps what you dictated, and the whole app ships as one self-contained AppImage.
